candidates.issues: Ingredients are capitalized, which is unnatural in Russian. Grammatical cases in the ingredient list are not always adjusted (e.g., '250 г Печенье' instead of '250 г печенья'). Imperial units (9 inches) were not converted to metric.

Left English culinary terms in parentheses in the ingredient list ('double cream', 'single cream'). Mistranslated 'white chocolate spread' as just 'white chocolate'. Did not convert inches to centimeters.

Very good adaptation of culinary terms ('сливки 10-20%' for single cream) and conversion of imperial units to metric in the text. Minor grammatical case mismatch in the ingredient list ('250 г печенье' instead of 'печенья'), likely due to keeping the source structure.

Capitalized ingredient names. Translated 'single cream' simply as 'сливки', losing the distinction. In the instructions, translated 'warm' (тёплый) as 'горячий' (hot). Did not convert inches to metric.
